settings.label: Card shadow
settings.info: Shadow intensity behind cards, from flat (0) to deep (100).

settings.label: Section style
settings.info: Controls whether sections use gradient or flat backgrounds

settings.label: Heading size
settings.info: Controls the size of section headlines across the theme. Individual sections can override this.

settings.label: Font weight
settings.info: Controls how bold body copy and headings render across the theme, independent of which font is selected.

settings.label: Letter spacing
settings.info: Controls letter spacing across all heading levels (h1-h6). Overrides the per-level letter spacing settings above.

settings.label: Heading case
settings.info: Controls whether section headings render as written or uppercase across the theme. Overrides the per-level text case settings above.

settings.label: Section spacing
settings.info: Controls the vertical gap between sections across the theme.

settings.label: Scroll animation intensity
settings.info: Controls how much sections animate as the shopper scrolls the page

settings.label: Per-page style overrides (managed by Forge)
settings.info: Do not edit manually - written automatically by the Forge app's per-page style customization feature. Editing or clearing it may cause individual pages to lose their custom style settings.

settings.label: Per-page header/footer color scheme map (managed by Forge)
settings.info: Do not edit manually - written automatically by the Forge app's per-page color customization feature.

settings.label: Enable scroll animations
settings.info: Visitors who prefer reduced motion never see them.
